subject.title: Windows: multiple gateway-down failure modes (kill-and-rebind restart loop, config-edit no-relaunch, browser launch crash, blocking pricing fetches)

question: Should this issue remain the canonical umbrella while maintainers split scoped fixes for Windows gateway lifecycle, invalid config recovery, browser launch isolation, pricing fetch behavior, and CLI shim handling?
rationale: The report combines multiple credible M4-stable gateway failures, but current main already partially hardens some branches and the remaining fixes cross product, service, plugin, and recovery boundaries.

options.title: Keep umbrella and split fixes
options.body: Use this issue as the incident tracker while opening or linking narrow fix PRs or sub-issues for each proven boundary.

options.title: Wait for live Windows proof first
options.body: Ask for Windows listener, process, browser, and startup timing proof before maintainers sponsor follow-up work.

options.title: Promote one narrow canonical sub-issue
options.body: Move the remaining actionable work to a narrower issue such as invalid-config boot recovery and close only after every other branch is linked or resolved.

recommendation.title: Keep umbrella and split fixes
recommendation.body: Use this issue as the incident tracker while opening or linking narrow fix PRs or sub-issues for each proven boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the broadest current-history signal across gateway lifecycle, Windows restart, pricing, and spawn paths involved in the umbrella.
